description: A documented information security policy, formally approved by the third party's management, in force at the time of the assessment, and communicated to the staff who deliver the Organization service.
requiredEvidence: The signed and dated policy, plus evidence of how it was communicated.

requirement: Named security owner for the Organization engagement
description: A specific person - by name and title - accountable for information security on this engagement, with a route to escalate to executive management.
requiredEvidence: Name, title and contact details, and an organisation chart or appointment letter showing the escalation route.

requirement: Risk assessment covering the Organization service
description: Information security risks to the Organization service are identified, assessed against defined criteria, assigned owners and treated. A corporate risk register that does not mention this service does not satisfy the control.
requiredEvidence: The risk methodology, and the risk register entries relating to the Organization service with owners and treatment status.

description: A current independent certification or audit report whose scope covers the service delivered to Organization - not merely the head office or an unrelated business line.
requiredEvidence: The certificate with its scope statement, or the audit report with its scope section, plus the current status of any nonconformities.

description: The third party has identified the legal, regulatory and contractual obligations that apply to the Organization service - including UAE data protection law where personal data is involved - and can show how each is met.
requiredEvidence: A compliance obligations register or equivalent, covering the Organization service.

requirement: Access granted only on documented approval
description: Every third-party individual with access to Organization systems or information holds that access on the strength of a documented, authorised request naming the person and the entitlement.
requiredEvidence: A completed access request for a sampled individual, showing the approval and the entitlement granted.

requirement: Access removed when a person leaves the engagement
description: Access is withdrawn on the day a person leaves the third party or moves off the Organization engagement, and there is a process that makes this happen rather than an intention that it should.
requiredEvidence: A sampled leaver record with the dated removal confirmation, plus the process document or ticket workflow that triggers it.

requirement: Least privilege and separation of duties
description: Individuals hold the minimum entitlements their role requires. Privileged accounts are separate from day-to-day accounts and are not shared between people.
requiredEvidence: A screenshot or extract of the entitlements actually granted for a sampled individual, alongside the approved request, so the two can be compared.

requirement: Multi-factor authentication on access to Organization systems and to the third party's own remote access
description: MFA is enforced - not merely available - for all remote and privileged access paths that touch the Organization service.
requiredEvidence: A screenshot showing the second factor being demanded on the actual system used for Organization work. A product datasheet claiming MFA support does not evidence enforcement.

description: The list of third-party individuals holding Organization access is reviewed at a defined frequency, and the review results in removals where they are due.
requiredEvidence: The most recent completed review record showing what was reviewed, by whom, when, and what changed as a result.

description: Binding confidentiality obligations cover the third party as an entity and the individuals who touch Organization information, and they survive the end of the contract.
requiredEvidence: The executed NDA or the confidentiality clause reference in the contract, plus a sample individual undertaking where staff sign separately.

requirement: Organization information used only for the contracted purpose
description: Organization information is used solely to deliver the contracted service. It is not used for the third party's own analytics, product development, model training, benchmarking or marketing, and it is not shared onward without Organization's written consent.
requiredEvidence: The contract clause or policy statement that restricts use, and a list of any sub-processors with Organization's recorded approval for each.

requirement: Encryption of Organization data at rest
description: Organization information held on third-party systems, removable media or backups is encrypted with a current algorithm, and the keys are managed separately from the data.
requiredEvidence: Configuration evidence showing encryption enabled on the relevant stores, and a statement of the key management arrangement.

description: The third party can state where Organization data is stored, processed and backed up, at country level, and that location is permitted under the contract. Any processing outside the UAE has Organization's written approval on file.
requiredEvidence: A written statement of storage, processing and backup locations, plus the Organization approval where any of them sits outside the UAE.

requirement: Privacy impact assessment and personal data controls
description: Where personal data is processed, the third party has assessed the privacy impact of the Organization process specifically, honours data subject rights, and holds a data processing agreement with Organization.
requiredEvidence: The DPIA covering this process, the executed data processing agreement, and the procedure for handling a data subject request.

requirement: Malware protection on systems used for Organization work
description: Every endpoint and server used to deliver the Organization service runs malware protection that is enabled, current and centrally monitored.
requiredEvidence: A console screenshot or report showing the product, enabled status and definition date across the relevant estate.

requirement: Vulnerability management with defined remediation timeframes
description: Systems supporting the Organization service are scanned or assessed on a defined cycle, and vulnerabilities are remediated within stated timeframes by severity.
requiredEvidence: The most recent scan or assessment report, the remediation SLA, and the current status of critical and high findings.

description: Security patches are applied within the third party's stated timeframe, and there is no unremediated critical patch outstanding beyond it on systems that support the Organization service.
requiredEvidence: A patch status report dated within the last month for the relevant systems.

description: Systems are built to a documented hardening standard, and conformance to it is checked rather than assumed.
requiredEvidence: The hardening standard or baseline, plus a configuration review or compliance report against it.

description: Security-relevant events on systems supporting the Organization service are logged, the logs are protected from alteration, retained for a defined period, and actually reviewed or alerted on.
requiredEvidence: The logging standard stating what is captured and for how long, and evidence that alerts are acted on - a sample alert and its disposition.

requirement: Encryption of Organization data in transit
description: All transfer of Organization information uses TLS 1.2 or above, or equivalent protection. No cleartext protocol carries Organization data at any point in the path.
requiredEvidence: Certificate details or a scan result for the endpoints used, showing the protocol versions and cipher suites accepted.

description: Any network connection between the third party and Organization is documented, restricted to the ports, protocols and addresses the service requires, and reviewed. No any-to-any rule touches the Organization path.
requiredEvidence: The firewall or ACL rule set covering the Organization connection, and the date of its last review.

description: Organization systems, data or traffic are separated from the third party's other environments and from other customers, by network segmentation, separate tenancy or equivalent.
requiredEvidence: A current architecture diagram showing the separation, or the tenancy model where the service is multi-tenant.

requirement: Secure development for software built or maintained for Organization
description: Where the third party writes or maintains code for Organization, security is addressed through the development lifecycle: requirements, secure coding, testing before release, and separation of development from production.
requiredEvidence: The secure development policy, plus evidence a security gate was actually applied to an Organization release - a test report or a signed release record.

description: Software delivered to Organization is security tested before release and periodically thereafter, and the findings are remediated.
requiredEvidence: The most recent application security test or penetration test report for the Organization application, with the remediation status of each finding.

description: Individuals assigned to the Organization engagement are screened before they start, proportionate to the sensitivity of what they will access.
requiredEvidence: A completed screening record for a sampled individual working on the Organization service, and the screening standard applied.

description: Information security responsibilities are written into the terms of employment or engagement of the people who deliver the Organization service, and survive their departure.
requiredEvidence: The relevant clause from a template contract, and confirmation it applies to the Organization team.

description: People working on the Organization engagement receive information security and privacy awareness training on joining and at least annually.
requiredEvidence: Completion records naming individuals on the Organization engagement, dated within the last twelve months.

description: The third party maintains a current list of individuals working on the Organization engagement, and tells Organization when someone joins or leaves it.
requiredEvidence: The current team list, and the agreed notification route with an example of it being used.

description: There is a defined consequence for a member of staff who breaches information security requirements, and staff know it exists.
requiredEvidence: The disciplinary policy section covering information security.

requirement: Incident notification to Organization within a defined timeframe
description: The third party will notify Organization of any incident affecting Organization information or services within a stated maximum time, through a named route, and will not wait for its own investigation to conclude first. Organization requires no more than 24 hours from detection.
requiredEvidence: The written notification procedure showing the timeframe and the Organization contact route. A statement of intent without a stated clock does not satisfy this control.

description: There is a documented incident management process with defined roles, severity classification and escalation, covering the Organization service.
requiredEvidence: The incident response plan or procedure.

description: The incident response process has been exercised within the last twelve months, and the lessons were acted on.
requiredEvidence: The exercise or post-incident report, with the actions arising and their status.

description: The third party will preserve logs and evidence relevant to an Organization incident and cooperate with an Organization investigation, including giving Organization access to relevant records.
requiredEvidence: The contract clause or procedure covering evidence preservation and cooperation, and the log retention period.

description: The third party discloses any security incident in the last 24 months that affected customer data or service availability, and what changed as a result.
requiredEvidence: A written statement, with the remediation summary for each incident disclosed.

requirement: Return or destruction of Organization data at the end of the engagement
description: On termination or expiry the third party will return Organization information in an agreed format and then securely destroy its remaining copies, including backups, and certify that it has done so.
requiredEvidence: The contract clause or exit procedure covering return and destruction, and the destruction method and certification to be provided.

requirement: Backup and restore for Organization data
description: Organization information held by the third party is backed up on a defined schedule that meets the recovery point the service needs, and restores are tested rather than assumed.
requiredEvidence: The backup schedule showing frequency and retention, and the result of the most recent restore test.

requirement: Business continuity and disaster recovery plan
description: There is an approved continuity and recovery plan that names the Organization service, with stated recovery time and recovery point objectives.
requiredEvidence: The approved and dated plan, with the RTO and RPO for the Organization service.

description: The continuity or recovery plan has been tested within the last twelve months and the results were acted on.
requiredEvidence: The test report with results, gaps identified and actions taken.

description: Service levels relevant to security and availability are defined, measured and reported to Organization, and reviewed with Organization at a defined frequency.
requiredEvidence: The SLA definition, a recent performance report, and minutes of a review meeting with Organization.

description: Organization's data and workloads are logically isolated from those of other customers, and the mechanism is described rather than asserted.
requiredEvidence: A description of the isolation model, plus an architecture diagram or the provider's tenancy documentation.

description: Organization data is stored, processed and backed up in named regions, and those regions are permitted. Any replication outside the UAE is disclosed.
requiredEvidence: A written statement of the regions used for storage, processing, backup and disaster recovery.

description: Access to the management plane of the cloud service is restricted, MFA enforced, and administrative actions logged and reviewable.
requiredEvidence: A screenshot of the administrative role assignments and the MFA policy on the management plane, plus a sample of the administrative activity log.

description: The division of security responsibility between Organization and the provider is written down control by control, so nothing is assumed to be the other party's job.
requiredEvidence: The shared responsibility matrix covering the specific service Organization consumes.

description: Organization can extract its data in a usable, documented format within a stated timeframe, without depending on the provider's goodwill.
requiredEvidence: The documented export mechanism, the format, and the stated timeframe; ideally the result of an export test.

requirement: Organization data is not used to train or improve models
description: Organization information, including anything staff type into the service, is not used to train, fine-tune, evaluate or otherwise improve any model that serves other customers, unless Organization has agreed in writing.
requiredEvidence: The contract clause or the provider's data-use policy stating this, plus the configuration setting where it is a tenant option.

requirement: Purpose, limitations and intended use stated
description: The third party states what the model is for, what it is not to be used for, its known limitations, and the accuracy or error characteristics Organization should expect.
requiredEvidence: Model or system documentation - a model card, system card or equivalent - covering intended use and limitations.

description: Where the model's output affects a person or an operational decision, a competent person reviews it before it takes effect, and that person can override it.
requiredEvidence: A description of the oversight point in the process flow, and the record of a sample decision showing the human step.

description: The service defends against prompt injection, data leakage between tenants or sessions, and unsafe output, and it logs inputs and outputs sufficiently for Organization to investigate an incident.
requiredEvidence: A description of the safeguards with any test results, and the input/output logging and retention arrangement.

requirement: Model change control and performance monitoring
description: Model versions are controlled, performance and drift are monitored, and Organization is notified before a change that could materially alter the service's output.
requiredEvidence: The model change management procedure, the monitoring approach, and the Organization notification commitment.
